description: HTML file implementing the user interface for a database visualizer dashboard, including style definitions and JavaScript code for dynamic interactions such as fetching database info, toggling views, and rendering data tables.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting selected states and re-fetching data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses tables for a selected database and loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a particular database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from a specific table and renders it in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates and inserts an HTML table from data rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Returns HTML for a table cell, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expandable content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content if it exceeds a certain length or contains nested objects.
